craft_notes: Sthāyin: warning-joy. Close: road. Rejected: 'ignorant' flat — unawakened kept; 'hell' for saṃsāra — killed: wandering road kept.

lines: Of the unwakened, eager to hide self-standing, they cast down —
on the hard-to-cross, terrible wandering road.
l4.sanskrit_cite: aprabudhadhiyas tv ete svasthitisthaganodyatāḥ | pātayanti duruttāre ghore saṃsāravartmani

reads_against.argmap: Of unawakened minds eager to cover self-standing: they cast down on hard, terrible wandering road.
c1_essence: Unawakened coverers cast down on hard terrible road.
